Q. What AI features does the Bespoke AI refrigerator offer?
A. The Bespoke AI refrigerator uses advanced AI technology for smarter food management. With 'AI Vision built with Google Gemini', it automatically tracks food items using an internal camera, updating the food list in real time. The 'AI Food Manager' keeps track of your groceries, gives expiration date alarms, and suggests recipes based on what's inside. This makes kitchen management and cooking easier and more efficient.
